rows.label: How benefits are paid

values.*: Total actual charges, less the Affordable Choice base plan payment, less the deductible (paid by the insured to the provider); the rider pays the remaining charges up to {sdr.max} per calendar year

rows.note: From the brochure's page-3 worked example ($127,000 charges, $25,000 deductible, $250,000 CY max)

values.*: Benefits that are a direct result of a Specified Disease

Amputation; Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS); Angioplasty; Cancer (Internal Cancer); Coronary Artery Bypass Surgery; End Stage Renal Failure; Heart Attack; Heart Valve Surgery; Implantable Cardiac Defibrillator; Joint Replacement; Major Organ Failure/Major Organ Transplant; Pacemaker Implant; Ruptured Aneurysm; Stroke (Ischemic or Hemorrhagic)
Rider not available for children-only coverage

notes: Optional rider on Affordable Choice. Four deductible options ($25,000, $50,000, $75,000, $100,000) and two calendar year maximum options ($250,000, $500,000).
